title: Paywall Suspensions and Digital News Subscriptions
authors: Inyoung Chae; Jihyeon Ha; David A. Schweidel
eligible_reason: One paywall suspension event at a common date: treated users (Visit = visited during the suspension) vs matched non-visitors, with Post_day_k x Visit interactions for days after the suspension. Single onset, so not staggered. Main model is a Bayesian logit (brms bernoulli) with user random intercepts and time-varying session controls.
design_notes: Codes/1.main_analysis.R: brm(Start_subscription ~ Post_day_3..30 + Visit_X_Post_day_3..30 + session controls + factor(Month) + Weekend + traffic/social-mention controls + (1|ID), family bernoulli). 2.Sensitivity analyses.R: user-level glm/lm of monthly subscription start on Visit and pre-period covariates (matching/sensitivity). 3.value_of_unrestricted_access_analysis.R: volume/variety interactions.
data_files_note: Readme does not state that the data are synthetic.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not staggered (single suspension event); nonlinear random-effects model.
